columns.fragility_note: Healthcare system output proxy (Belgium COVID-19 epidemic). Derived from ECDC daily data; already in [0,1].
columns.manipulability_note: Testing capacity constraints early in pandemic (early 2020) affect confirmed case counts underlying this proxy.

columns.fragility_note: Epidemic resilience proxy (Belgium COVID-19). Already in [0,1]; captures health system reserve capacity.
columns.manipulability_note: Hospital capacity reporting changed across Belgian waves; underreporting likely in wave 1 (Mar-May 2020).

columns.fragility_note: Integration/interaction proxy (Belgium COVID-19). Already in [0,1]; captures viral spread network dynamics.
columns.manipulability_note: Contact tracing completeness varied across epidemic phases; proxy reflects official data quality.

columns.fragility_note: Healthcare demand proxy (Belgium COVID-19). Raw values were outside [0,1] (ranged up to ~21); min-max normalization applied.
columns.manipulability_note: ICU bed demand figures depend on admission thresholds, which changed with Belgian crisis standards.

columns.fragility_note: Epidemic stability proxy (Belgium COVID-19). Already in [0,1]; captures suppression level.
columns.manipulability_note: Vaccination rollout starting late 2020 structurally shifts this proxy; pre/post-vaccine periods not distinguished.

notes: Belgium COVID-19 epidemic pilot dataset sourced from ECDC daily surveillance data, covering daily observations from 2019-12-31 to approximately mid-2021 (350 rows). O=healthcare output proxy, R=epidemic resilience proxy, I=integration/interaction proxy, demand=healthcare demand proxy (normalized from raw), S=epidemic stability proxy. Most columns were already in [0,1]; demand required min-max normalization. Dataset spans the first two major COVID-19 epidemic waves in Belgium.
